title: Animations and transitions
goal: Use motion to explain state without blocking access.
explanation: A transition animates a property between states. A keyframe animation can describe several stages. Keep motion purposeful: a focus or hover transition can acknowledge interaction.
Prefer short effects and test performance. Transform and opacity often avoid layout work, but do not assume an effect is fast without measuring it.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Do not make essential information depend only on animation, hover, or colour. Keyboard users should receive clear focus feedback.
exercise: Add a subtle button transition and a reduced-motion alternative.
hint: Use a media query for prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

quiz.question: Which preference should you respect when reducing decorative motion?
quiz.explanation: The reduced-motion media feature lets the page respond to that user preference.
